Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class EvaluationCsvDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.EvaluationCsvDTO
public class EvaluationCsvDTO extends Object
DTO for CSV export of evaluation data.

Designed for integration with OpenCSV, this DTO maps evaluation attributes to specific column names in a CSV file using @CsvBindByName. It also formats date-time fields consistently with @CsvDate. Includes a constructor for quick transformation from EvaluationDTO.

Fields include: - Evaluation metadata (ID, scale, status, feedback) - Timestamps (created/edited) - Evaluation cycle info (IDs, dates) - Evaluatee and evaluator details (ID, name, email) Example usage: 

     List<EvaluationCsvDTO> exportList = evaluations.stream()
         .map(EvaluationCsvDTO::new)
         .collect(Collectors.toList());
